meta.title: Self-help tools and wellbeing check-ins
meta.description: Wellbeing check-ins and guided planners to help you understand your wellbeing — no login, nothing stored.

hero.title: Tools for your wellbeing
hero.lead: Quick check-ins and practical planners you can use right now. Nothing you answer here is stored or shared with anyone.

assessments.title: Wellbeing check-ins
assessments.intro: Short questionnaires that help you reflect on how you have been feeling. These are not diagnoses. Your answers stay in your browser and are never sent anywhere.

guides.title: Practical tools you can use today
guides.intro: Step-by-step resources for conversations, budgeting and legal preparation.

runner.nothingStored: Nothing you answered was stored or sent anywhere.
runner.instantResult: You see your result immediately, with suggested next steps.
